question: For the exact 891 MW modeled alternative (resized-compressor-1700-network-scaledflows-0.85) under no-breeding-credit and assumed-new-tritium-feed-100: net generation, annual electricity, overnight and financed capital, annual operating cost including fuel, replacement and terminal cashflows, LCOE contributions and total; the differences from the 423 MW baseline, the unscaled control and the separately labelled source-conditioned branch; an aligned-convention ladder toward the published ARIES economics with every substitution labelled; and which declared uncertainties change the comparison materially. No case is tuned toward the published 77.6 USD2004/MWh. The ladder is reported one-at-a-time from each step's named base, cumulatively in the stated order L3 → L4 → L5 → L6, and combined; the residual is reported at every swept discount rate and no rate is designated as the published one.

axes.basis: Lyon Table IV prints 1000 MW net (the branch default); 891.0016527219543 is this case's own net, so the branch then substitutes the source capital scope alone.
axes.missing_response: The source-conditioned branch substitutes a supplied denominator and already-financed capital; nothing physical responds.

axes.basis: E7/F8 allowance 70 M [35, 140]; 80,893,344 is target-derived from Lyon's 14 % of CoE (source-boundary), labelled diagnostic.
axes.missing_response: Fixed allowance; no staffing or maintenance model responds.

axes.basis: F3 40 [30, 60]; 47 = 40 full-power years / 0.85 rounded to the integer the model requires.
axes.missing_response: Financial assumption; no financing, liability or service-life evidence responds; no engineering optimum.

axes.basis: E8 5 [2, 8]; 3.7673466400138413 = 5 x 1468.361/1948.8 (fluence-scaled applicability point); 2.907407 = source cadence 15.7/5.4 (E8).
axes.missing_response: Selected life; no damage or fluence model responds.

axes.basis: E8 1 [0.5, 2]; 1.038330309484732 = 75,000,000 / 72,231,350 (source event price over the selected scope).
axes.missing_response: Event price factor; no procurement model.

axes.basis: F7: 0 (no credit), 100 (named scenario), 50, 150; 138.7304019114013 equals this case's gross makeup (purchase floor / self-sufficiency diagnostic).
axes.missing_response: Net extracted breeder feed has no qualified capability or extraction-cost model; exhaust recycling is already credited.

axes.basis: F7: 0 or 30 M (named scenario); 10 M and 100 M.
axes.missing_response: Incremental assumed service cost has no price-versus-capability relation.
Assumed price; no market model.
Supplied availability has no outage or reliability response.

axes.basis: F1 0.05 [0, 0.10]; the source rate is not printed.
axes.missing_response: Financial assumption; no financing, liability or service-life evidence responds; no engineering optimum.
Financial assumption; no financing, liability or service-life evidence responds; no engineering optimum.

axes.basis: F4 0.10 [0.05, 0.20]; the source 0.5 mills/kWh (1992 $) is unconvertible.
axes.missing_response: Financial assumption; no financing, liability or service-life evidence responds; no engineering optimum.

axes.basis: E4 [0.5, 1.5] on the changed equipment.
axes.missing_response: Supplied price factor has no calibrated market or equipment-quality response.

axes.basis: E4 [0.5, 1.5] applied jointly to the cycle-side allowances sized for the 1253 MW gross source plant, plus a 2.0 corner; the corner designs set the compressor, conversion-services and secondary-transport factors to the same value.
axes.missing_response: Fixed source-scope allowances; no response to gross power or flow.

axes.basis: [ASSUMED] recuperator bound: NTU 4 -> 19 (x 4.75) with capacity rate x 1.214 gives a UA-proportional x 5.8; factors 2, 4, 6 on the whole 62.912 M allowance.
axes.missing_response: The 0.95 recuperator has no purchase, rating or screen (audit item 1).

axes.basis: Flow-proportional proxy 1700/1400 = 1.214 and the E4 upper bound 1.5.
axes.missing_response: Fixed allowance; no response to cycle flow (audit item 2).

axes.basis: 0 cubic proxy (baseline); 1 declared fixed power.
axes.missing_response: Mode switch; no hydraulic model.

axes.basis: [ASSUMED] order-of-magnitude bound 10 and 30 MW for PbLi MHD pumping that E3 leaves unmodelled; the baseline 0.01 MW is a placeholder.
axes.missing_response: No PbLi hydraulic or MHD model; no heat recovery (pbli_recovery 0).

axes.basis: 1700 (the declared alternative); 1600 adverse control (screen fails by 67.033 MW).
axes.missing_response: Scalar screen and linear cost; no compressor map.

axes.basis: 3359 (declared mapping value); 3261 adverse control (screen fails by 98 kg/s).
axes.missing_response: Scalar screen and linear cost; no pump map.

axes.basis: 0 selected-quantity estimates; 1 fixed source budgets (the disclosed nonresponse).
axes.missing_response: Mode switch; not a hardware-cost law.
